I am a 48-year-old woman farming in the South South region, where the rains are plentiful and we grow plenty of cassava and yam. This 0.20-hectare plot is rented, so I must make it pay, but I also cannot spend too much on inputs I cannot afford. I managed to get a small bag of subsidized NPK fertilizer from the agro-dealer, which I will spread lightly, and I always mix in compost and poultry manure into the mounds because that is how my mother taught me. I plant local cassava cuttings and local yam setts saved from last season, as the improved ones are scarce and costly here.
